inj.note: Per head coach Kevin O'Connell, Jennings suffered a calf injury at Thursday's practice that is serious enough to sideline him for at least one game. Jennings' next chance for game action is Sunday, Nov. 15 in Green Bay, while Tai Felton and Myles Price are in for some offensive snaps this week behind the top WR duo of Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison.

news.h: Vikings WR Jauan Jennings on rebuffing return to 49ers: 'I love where I'm at'
news.d: Jauan Jennings said he rebuffed the chance to return to the 49ers via trade despite struggling to produce for the Vikings because "I love where I'm at."

news.h: Niners' Kyle Shanahan says Jauan Jennings told him he's 'happy' with Vikings
news.d: Niners coach Kyle Shanahan said Jauan Jennings' decision not to return to San Francisco came after the two had a "good talk" via FaceTime.

news.h: Source: Jauan Jennings wanted to stay with Vikings amid 49ers trade talks
news.d: Jauan Jennings expressed his desire to stay in Minnesota after the 49ers tried to reacquire the wide receiver in trade talks with the Vikings.
